Xavier Girard is a Staff Backend Engineer at NexaCorp who consistently drives high-impact engineering solutions in SaaS infrastructure. His work bridges technical rigor with operational scalability, making him a key asset to any team.  

Xavier owns AWS migrations and cost optimization, reducing infrastructure spend by 30% during a monorepo rearchitect. He architected core microservices in Go, boosting API response times by 40% while maintaining 99.95% SLA. His Kubernetes clusters handle auto-scaling for 10M+ daily users, cutting deployment downtime by 50% through proactive resource tuning.  

He standardized Terraform across teams, slashing provisioning time by 25% and eliminating 80% of manual config errors. Xavier’s PostgreSQL optimizations cut read latency by 60%, and his REST API designs—complete with rate limiting and async workflows—handle 10x traffic spikes without degradation. His systems are battle-tested, with zero critical outages in 18 months.  

Xavier’s strength lies in turning complex problems into elegant, scalable solutions. He’s a reliable collaborator who balances technical depth with clear communication, ensuring teams align on both goals and execution. I’d welcome the chance to collaborate with him again.
